answer: Vesting delays drain sybil farms like water through karst: rewards land locked for 30 epochs, and any slashing of a bad attestation in that window claws back the whole unvested balance. An attacker spinning up 500 fake agents must fund each one's work for a month before seeing a coin, while one exposed cluster forfeits everything. Mapping the ledger like an atlas of who-attested-whom makes those clusters visible, so no fake identity finds a safe haven to cash out.
